footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Zevra Therapeutics: after $5.6M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 4.5× to $106M in 2025. Gross margin was 84.5%, versus 68.6% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $62.9M from $87.0M.
Net income was $77.6M, or $1.35 per share, after a $106M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was −$1.6M and free cash flow −$2.4M, versus −$69.7M.
sources: Zevra Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
